Article XI

A complete, process walkthrough of the Article XI tax-exemption approval process in the NYC HPD PIMS system — from the trigger on the pipeline project through the Article XI module and its three milestones (Initial Package Review, Speaker Letter, and Final Package Sign-Off) to City Council’s Resolution Letter.

This guide follows one Article XI package end to end so you can see what each screen does and what to expect next.

Tip: click any screenshot to enlarge it for a closer look.

About This Guide

Article XI of the NY Private Housing Finance Law lets HPD grant a partial or full real-estate tax exemption to an affordable housing project, subject to City Council approval. In PIMS it is handled as a module on the project and is triggered when the project’s tax exemption is Article XI.

  • Triggered when Tax Exemption Proposed = Yes and Tax Exemption = Article XI; once the application is In Pipeline, PIMS auto-creates the Article XI module. The Program PM can also start this process manually from the project page by clicking the Initiate Process button.
  • The module is worked through three milestones, each with reviews and approvals across HPD units and City Council:
    • Initial Package Review
    • Speaker Letter
    • Final Package Sign-Off

Login is not covered here. Each part begins from the screen you see immediately after signing in.

Purpose of This Guide

A hands-on training reference. Each step pairs an actual screenshot with a clear Action (what to do) and Result (what to expect), with references to the Article XI Visio future-state flow for traceability.

Who Should Use This Guide

  • Program — Program PM, Program Director/ED, and Program Assistant Commissioner.
  • Tax Credits & Discretionary Exemptions (TCDE) — TCDE Analyst, TCDE Deputy Director, and TCDE Director/ED.
  • Legal Affairs — the Dep. Gen. Counsel of Tax Incentives & Housing Supervision and General Counsel.
  • Intergovernmental Affairs (IGA) and City Council, plus the Housing Incentives AC and Deputy Commissioner of Development.

Before You Begin

  • A valid PIMS account with the appropriate role/queue (Program, TCDE, Legal, or IGA).
  • The project must have Tax Exemption = Article XI so the Article XI module is auto-created — or the Program PM can start it manually from the project page using the Initiate Process button.
  • The Article XI package components ready — Underwriting Analysis, Deed, Certificates of Occupancy/I-Cards, Organizational Chart, Draft Regulatory & Existing Agreements — plus the Speaker Letter and Resolution Letter.
  • A supported web browser (latest Google Chrome recommended).

Process at a Glance

  • 1Article XI is triggered at intake (Tax Exemption = Article XI) and auto-creates on the pipeline project — or the Program PM starts it manually from the project page via Initiate Process
  • 2Program PM completes the module Review Checklist, assigns TCDE personas, and uploads the underwriting
  • 3Milestone 1 — Initial Package Review: TCDE Analyst then Director/ED review & approve
  • 4Milestone 2 — Speaker Letter: drafted by TCDE Analyst; reviewed by TCDE Deputy/Director/ED and Legal Affairs
  • 5Milestone 3 — Final Package Sign-Off: sequential signatures, then route to IGA
  • 6IGA outreach to City Council → hearing → Resolution Letter issued & uploaded
  • 7All three milestones complete → Article XI module Completed (tax exemption approved)

Part A — From the Pipeline Project to the Article XI Module

Step 1: Open the Proposal Application

Action Open the New Construction Intake application. Its status is In Pipeline, so the project has been created. Under Financial Information, Tax Exemption Proposed = Yes and Tax Exemption = Article XI — this is what makes the Article XI process apply. In the Projects related list, click Atlantic Housing Partners LLC to open the project record.

Result Because the tax exemption is Article XI, PIMS automatically created an Article XI module on the project. You navigate to the project record where that module lives.

Process map reference: Visio — Start: Article XI package data captured during Intake.

Step 2: Open the Project and Go to Modules

Action On the project record you can see all the project information across the tabs (Details, Programs, Buildings, Entities, Project Funding’s, Modules, and more). To work the auto-created Article XI process, click the Modules tab. This process can also be started manually here: the Program PM clicks the Initiate Process button (top-right) and selects Article XI.

Result The project’s Modules list opens; if the module was not auto-created, Initiate Process lets the Program PM start it manually.

Step 3: Open the Auto-Created Article XI Module

Action In the Modules list, the Article XI module (Record Type Article XI, status In Progress) was created automatically. Click it to open.

Result The Article XI module opens, ready to be worked.

Step 4: Start the Review Checklist

Action As the Program PM, on the Article XI module click Review Checklist (top-right). The project’s Program PM is set as the Owner of this module.

Result Guidance instructs you to review each checklist item and set All Checklist Items Have Been Reviewed to True to begin the milestone process.

Step 5: Complete the Review Checklist

Action Complete all the fields as required, and be sure to check All Checklist Items Have Been Reviewed. Then click Save.

Result The checklist is saved and the milestone process can begin.

Step 6: Checklist Complete — Next Steps

Action Guidance confirms the checklist review is complete. Next, populate the TCDE Director/Deputy Director/ED and TCDE Analyst persona fields, and upload the Underwriting Analysis under Documents.

Result The module tells the PM exactly what to do next.

Step 7: Assign the TCDE Personas

Action In the TCDE Personas section, click the pencil to edit the TCDE Director/Deputy Director/ED and TCDE Analyst fields.

Result The persona fields open for editing.

Step 8: Set and Save the TCDE Personas

Action Set the TCDE Director/Deputy Director/ED and TCDE Analyst, then click Save.

Result The assigned TCDE personas — who will review and approve the Article XI package — are recorded on the module.

Step 9: Open the Documents Tab

Action Open the Documents tab on the module.

Result The Document Checklist shows the Underwriting Analysis as Pending.

Step 10: Upload the Underwriting Analysis

Action On the Underwriting Analysis line, click the upload icon.

Result The upload dialog opens.

Step 11: Choose and Upload the File

Action Choose the Underwriting Analysis file and click Upload.

Result The file is attached to the module.

Step 12: Underwriting Analysis Submitted

Action Review the document line, then click the Details tab.

Result The Underwriting Analysis status updates to Submitted, and the first milestone — Initial Package Review — is created.

Step 13: The Initial Package Review Milestone is Created

Action On the module, the Milestones list now shows Article XI Initial Package Review (M-…), status Ready for Review. Open it.

Result The Article XI process moves into its first milestone.

Part B — Milestone 1: Initial Package Review

Step 14: Open the Initial Package Review Milestone

Action This milestone is auto-created when you complete the Review Checklist process. It opens on Not Started — update the status to In Progress to begin.

Result The milestone is active and the Owner (PM) is guided to prepare and upload the Initial Package.

Process map reference: Visio Step 1 — Review & screen the submitted Article XI package.

Step 15: Go to Documents and Upload the Initial Package

Action Click the Documents tab to upload the Article XI Initial Package. You can also refer to the steps in the Guidance for Success shown on the milestone.

Result The Documents tab opens for the Initial Package.

Step 16: Upload the Initial Package

Action On the Documents tab, the Article XI Initial Package shows as Pending. Click the upload icon.

Result The upload dialog opens.

Step 17: Choose and Upload the Package

Action Choose the Initial Package file and click Upload.

Result The Initial Package is attached to the milestone.

Step 18: Submit the Package for Approval

Action Once the Initial Package document is Submitted, the Submit for Approval button appears in the top-right corner. Click Submit for Approval — the dialog shown here opens; add the appropriate comments and click Submit.

Result The Initial Package is routed for review.

Process map reference: Visio Step 1 — TCDE Analyst reviews the package submitted from the Program PM.

Step 19: TCDE Analyst Review Begins

Action The milestone advances to TCDE Analyst Review. Click the Approval Work Item tab to see the approval process stages.

Result The package is now with the TCDE Analyst.

Step 20: Approval Work Item — TCDE Analyst Stage

Action The Approval Work Item shows the item assigned at the TCDE Analyst Stage.

Result You can see the package is with the TCDE Analyst.

Step 21: Log in as the TCDE Analyst

Action Log in as the TCDE Analyst. On the Home page, Atlantic Housing Partners LLC shows status Assigned under Action Items — click View.

Result The assigned Article XI review opens for the TCDE Analyst.

Step 22: Open and Review the File

Action The Article XI Initial Package Review milestone opens. On the Documents tab, click the eye icon to review the file.

Result The uploaded file opens for review.

Step 23: Verify the Document

Action The TCDE Analyst reviews the file and can Request Additional Info, Reject Document, or Verify. Click Verify.

Result The document is verified.

Process map reference: Visio Step 2 — Is additional information needed?.

Step 24: Add Comments and Submit

Action Add comments and click Submit.

Result The verification and comments are recorded.

Step 25: Record the Approval Decision

Action On the right, the Action Item is the approval step. Select Approve/Reject, add comments, and click Submit.

Result The TCDE Analyst’s approval decision is recorded and the milestone advances.

Step 26: Initial Package Review Complete

Action On the TCDE Analyst’s approval, the system automatically advances the status path to Completed (Article XI Stage Approved, Sub-Stage Article XI Package Review Completed). Click the Article XI module to navigate back to the module.

Result The first milestone is complete.

Part C — Milestone 2: Speaker Letter

Step 27: Speaker Letter Milestone Created

Action On the module, the Article XI Initial Package Review milestone is Completed. The completion of this milestone is the trigger that creates a new Speaker Letter milestone (status Ready for Review). Click the Speaker Letter milestone ID to open it.

Result The process moves into the Speaker Letter milestone.

Process map reference: Visio Step 3 — Draft Speaker Letter & Article XI Package.

Step 28: Open the Speaker Letter Milestone

Action The Speaker Letter milestone opens on Not Started. As the TCDE Analyst, you will prepare and upload the Speaker Letter. Update the status to In Progress to begin.

Result The Speaker Letter milestone is active.

Step 29: Go to the Documents Tab

Action Guidance instructs the TCDE Analyst to prepare and upload the Speaker Letter. Click the Documents tab.

Result The Documents tab opens, showing the Speaker Letter as Pending.

Step 30: Upload the Speaker Letter

Action Click the upload button and upload the Speaker Letter.

Result The Speaker Letter is uploaded.

Process map reference: Visio Step 3 — Draft Speaker Letter & Article XI Package.

Step 31: Submit for Approval

Action Once the Speaker Letter is uploaded/submitted by the TCDE Analyst, the Submit for Approval button appears in the top-right corner. Click the Submit for Approval button.

Result The record is submitted for approval to the TCDE Director review.

Process map reference: Visio Step 4 — Submit the draft to the TCDE Deputy Director.

Step 32: Add Comments and Submit

Action Add comments and click Submit.

Result The record is submitted for the TCDE Director review.

Step 33: Open the Approval Work Item

Action Click the Approval Work Item tab, where you can see the next approval stage and to whom the record’s approval is assigned.

Result The approval routing for the record is shown.

Step 34: Record Assigned to the TCDE Director

Action On the Approval Work Item, the record is assigned to Niti Jadeja, the TCDE Director (this is the user we assigned as the TCDE Director at the module level).

Result You can see the record is with the TCDE Director for review.

Step 35: Log in as the TCDE Director

Action Log in as the TCDE Director. On the Home page, under Action Items, the Atlantic Housing Partners LLC project appears — click View.

Result The assigned Speaker Letter review opens.

Step 36: View the Submitted Speaker Letter

Action You are navigated to the Speaker Letter milestone. On the Documents tab, click the eye icon to view the submitted Speaker Letter.

Result The submitted Speaker Letter opens for review.

Step 37: Verify the Speaker Letter

Action The TCDE Director has three options — Request Info, Reject Document, or Verify. Following the happy path, click Verify.

Result The document is verified.

Process map reference: Visio Step 5 — TCDE reviews the draft letter.

Step 38: Add Comments and Submit

Action Add comments and click Submit.

Result The verification and comments are recorded.

Step 39: Record the Approval Decision

Action On the right, the Action Item shows the approval process assigned to the TCDE Director Review stage. Select the approval decision Approve, add comments, and click Submit.

Result The TCDE Director’s approval is recorded.

Step 40: Routed to the Deputy General Counsel

Action On the Approval Work Item, after the TCDE Director stage the record routes to the Deputy General Counsel (Legal team).

Result The Speaker Letter moves to Legal Affairs for review.

Process map reference: Visio Step 6 — Approval of Draft Speaker Letter (Dep. Gen. Counsel).

Step 41: Program PM — Sponsor Confirmation

Action Once the approval process is completed, the action comes to the Program PM: “Has the approved Speaker Letter been sent to the Project Sponsor?” Select Yes or No, add comments, and click Submit.

Result The Program PM’s response is recorded.

Process map reference: Visio Step 7 — Program routing to the Project Sponsor.

Step 42: Speaker Letter Milestone Complete

Action Once the Program PM confirms (in the previous step) that the approved Speaker Letter has been sent to the Project Sponsor, that response triggers the Speaker Letter milestone to be marked Approved and Completed. Click the Article XI module to navigate back.

Result The Speaker Letter milestone is complete.

Step 43: Final Package Sign-Off Milestone Created

Action You are navigated to the Article XI – Atlantic Housing Partners LLC module, where the Speaker Letter milestone is approved and completed. The completion of the Speaker Letter milestone is the trigger that creates a new Article XI Final Package Sign Off milestone (status Not Started, Ready for Review). Click the Article XI Final Package Sign Off milestone to open it.

Result The process moves into the Final Package Sign-Off milestone.

Part D — Milestone 3: Final Package Sign-Off & City Council Resolution

Step 44: Open the Final Package Sign-Off Milestone

Action Open the Article XI Final Package Sign Off milestone and update the status to In Progress. This milestone routes the package for signatures and on to City Council.

Result The final milestone is active.

Step 45: Go to the Documents Tab

Action Click the Documents tab.

Result You are navigated to the Documents tab, where the Article XI Final Package Sign Off shows as Pending.

Step 46: Upload the Final Package

Action Click the upload button and upload the Article XI Final Package Sign Off document.

Result The Final Package document is attached.

Step 47: Submit for Approval

Action The Article XI Final Package Sign Off now shows Submitted status. In the top-right corner, click Submit for Approval.

Result The Submit for Approval dialog opens.

Process map reference: Visio Steps 9–15 — Sign the Article XI Package.

Step 48: Add Comments and Submit

Action Add comments and click Submit.

Result The Final Package is routed for approval.

Step 49: Open the Approval Work Item

Action Navigate to the Approval Work Item tab.

Result The approval routing for the Final Package is shown.

Step 50: Program PM Final Review — Certificate to Proceed

Action On the Approval Work Item, the record moves through the Program PM and all the other approval stages; once completed, it reaches the Program PM Final Review stage. On the right, the Action Item asks: considering funding and project criteria, does this project require a Certificate to Proceed?

Result The record reaches the Program PM Final Review stage, where the Certificate to Proceed question is answered.

Process map reference: Visio Steps 9–17 — Signatures; assess Certificate to Proceed.

Step 51: Confirm Certificate to Proceed

Action On the approval Action Item, select the appropriate option (Yes or No), add comments, and click Submit.

Result The Certificate to Proceed requirement is recorded.

Step 52: Article V & Land Use Questions

Action This is the next step of the same reviewer’s approval process — the reviewer does not change. After the Program PM answers whether a Certificate to Proceed is required (regardless of Yes or No), the Program PM Final Review stage presents a new set of questions — Is Article V required? and Is there a Land Use action? Select the appropriate options, add comments, and click Submit.

Result The Article V and Land Use determinations are recorded.

Step 53: Submit Package to IGA

Action A new Action Item — Submit Package to IGA Review — appears: has the package been reviewed and is it ready for IGA submission? Select Yes, add comments, and click Submit.

Result The package is submitted for review to IGA (Intergovernmental Affairs).

Process map reference: Visio Step 18 — Route Article XI Package to IGA.

Step 54: Log in as IGA — Upload the Resolution Letter

Action Log in as the IGA reviewer. Move to the Documents tab, where the Resolution Letter shows as Pending. As the IGA persona, add (upload) the Resolution Letter.

Result The Resolution Letter is uploaded.

Process map reference: Visio Steps 22–24 — City Council hearing & Resolution Letter.

Step 55: Confirm the Resolution Letter

Action The Resolution Letter now shows Submitted. On the right, under the Action Item, select Yes, add comments, and click Submit.

Result The Resolution Letter is confirmed.

Step 56: Final Package Milestone Complete

Action Once IGA confirms the Resolution Letter has been added and submitted, the milestone is Approved and Completed. Click the Article XI module to navigate back.

Result The Final Package Sign-Off milestone is complete.

Step 57: All Milestones Complete

Action You are navigated to the Article XI – Atlantic Housing Partners LLC module. Under the Milestones section, all milestones are Completed and Approved, and at the top the Article XI module itself shows Completed. Click Projects to open the project.

Result The Article XI module is fully complete.

Part E — Wrap-Up

Step 58: Open the Project Modules

Action On the project record you can see all the project details. Click the Modules tab.

Result The project’s Modules list opens.

Step 59: End of the Flow

Action In the Modules list you can see additional modules have been created: the C&S Underwriting module (created as a sub-process of Article XI) and the CP - Original module (created because the Program PM selected Yes for the ‘Is a Certificate to Proceed required?’ question during the Final Review). The Article XI module itself shows Completed.

Result This completes the Article XI process.

Summary

You followed an Article XI tax-exemption package from start to finish: triggered at intake (Tax Exemption = Article XI), which auto-creates the Article XI module on the pipeline project. The Program PM completes the review checklist, assigns TCDE personas, and uploads the underwriting. The package then moves through three milestones — Initial Package Review, Speaker Letter, and Final Package Sign-Off — with reviews/approvals across TCDE, Legal Affairs, the Assistant/Deputy Commissioners, IGA, and City Council. After the hearing, the Resolution Letter is issued and uploaded and the Article XI module is marked Completed.

Notes & Disclaimers

  • This guide follows the standard approved path; rejections route the package back for edits (Visio steps 4a/5a/6a/9a–15a). Repetitive approvals are condensed and shown via the Approval Work Item tab.
  • Some steps (City Council outreach, hearings) happen outside PIMS; PIMS records the key dates, documents, and approvals.
  • Screens, field names, and buttons may vary by role, permissions, browser, and future PIMS updates. Names/IDs/data are from a training/sandbox environment.
